request:
Suicide-YF consists of Mandarin Chinese speech recordings from 1,223 adolescents aged 10--18 years recruited in Guangdong, China. 
The participants were asked to complete an online survey, in which they were asked whether they had ever experienced suicidal thoughts or behaviours. Those who answered yes were invited to participate in the study. Additionally, a control group of children with no suicide risk was selected for comparison with the at-risk participants. Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
